title: 1924 Hartland High School Official opening August 26
description: Students soon outgrew the Hartland Superior School, and it became evident that a new building was needed. On August 27, 1924, a new two-story brick school with a large basement was opened for teachers, school board officials, and pupils, who gathered for an assembly to unofficially mark the occasion. The building featured seven classrooms, an assembly room with a platform, a library, two offices, a cloakroom, modern lavatory and toilet rooms, a furnace room with a fireproof door, an electric bell system, drinking fountains on each floor, and blinds on every window. The official opening was held on September 26, 1924, at 7:30 p.m., with Lieutenant Governor W.F. Todd formally declaring the school open. The building could accommodate up to 400 students, though enrollment at the time was 230.
